name: get_datetime
description: Current date and time: Persian (Jalali) and Gregorian date, weekday, local time and timezone, and whether it was verified online or read from the system clock.

name: get_user_profile
description: What Roadeep has learned about the user: preferences, habits, style and recent request patterns. Use it to tailor suggestions.

name: remember_about_user
description: Save one short, durable fact about the user (preference, habit, style or personal fact) so future suggestions fit them. Never store secrets, passwords or sensitive data.

name: forget_about_user
description: Forget saved facts about the user that contain these words (be specific; vague queries are refused).

name: get_settings
description: Read the app's current settings (sound, language, focus timer lengths, character, chat options).

name: update_settings
description: Change one or more app settings. Only include the fields to change.

name: set_character
description: Change the character's look: body shape, colour and resting expression (ids from get_character_options).

name: get_character_options
description: List the available character shapes, colours and expressions with their ids and names.

name: list_tasks
description: List the user's tasks.

name: add_task
description: Add a task, optionally due on a day (YYYY-MM-DD).

name: complete_task
description: Mark an open task done, by words from its title.

name: delete_task
description: Delete a task, by words from its title.

name: list_notes
description: List the user's notes, newest first; with query, only notes containing those words.

name: update_note
description: Replace the text of a note, found by words from it.

name: delete_note
description: Delete a note, found by words from it.

name: add_note
description: Add a short text note.

name: list_reminders
description: List upcoming reminders, soonest first.

name: add_reminder
description: Set a reminder. Give either at (local YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM) or inMinutes from now.

name: list_habits
description: List habits with today's status and streaks.

name: log_habit
description: Mark a habit done for today, by words from its title.

name: get_focus
description: Read the focus (Pomodoro) timer state.

name: control_focus
description: Start, pause, resume, skip or stop the focus timer. minutes only applies to start.

name: open_settings
description: Open the settings window on a section.

name: show_view
description: Show a screen of the island.

name: ask_roadeep
description: Send a question or request to the Roadeep chat (its model, tools and approval cards) and get the final text answer. Use for knowledge, reasoning, web, files and anything the other tools cannot do.
